summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase shipping pipeline for GSD Phase 68 (verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, ship, resolve PR reviews, extract learnings) without requiring user babysitting.
summary.outcome: Completed verify/secure/validate/simplify stages, found and fixed a real key-zeroization-order bug plus several CodeRabbit-flagged issues (rotation guards, anti-rollback checks, dead code), got the SDK E2E gate green after fixing local TEE-worker/env issues, extracted phase learnings, and committed all fixes across multiple logical commits — PR creation/ship and final review-thread resolution were still in progress at the point the transcript ends.

repo: apps/api's TEE_WORKER_URL defaults to :3001, which is actually the mock-ipns-routing service locally — the real tee-worker runs on :3002; this mismatch silently breaks TEE-dependent SDK E2E tests.
The local tee-worker Docker container can run a stale pre-phase contract; it must be rebuilt from current source before trusting SDK E2E TEE test results.

packages/sdk/src/client.ts's enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed a parent readKey before the children loop finished unsealing with it, misclassifying every depth-2+ move descendant as unreadable — a real bug caught by manual review, not by existing tests.
apps/web's ipns.service.test.ts fails on `main` too (pre-existing, unrelated to phase 68) and web vitest is not wired into CI at all, so this breakage goes undetected.

GSD executor commits on this repo were already conventional-format in phase 68 (scope-parens like `feat(sdk):` are valid; only the description part must avoid parens) — the filter-branch reword step was a no-op this time.
apps/api/src/shares/shares.service.ts's updateGrant had no service-level test coverage before this phase despite handling rootGeneration; needed a monotonic anti-rollback guard plus new spec cases.
ResolveRotationContext carried a redundant field where the single production caller in useFileBrowserActions.ts already supplied ipnsName directly.

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed the parent readKey before the children loop unsealed with it; fixed with a red-green-verified regression test (client-move-enumerate.test.ts).
updateGrant lacked a monotonic rootGeneration anti-rollback guard; added guard plus new spec cases and later reworked for a transaction-based flow after CodeRabbit re-review.
ResolveRotationContext had a redundant field beyond ipnsName that the sole production caller already passed; removed after CodeRabbit re-review flagged it.
Multiple CodeRabbit findings fixed here: raw error logs replaced, plus floor-gating/persistence hardening across several edits.

workflow: For a long autonomous pipeline, running independent long steps (security audit, simplify review, client-chain build/SDK E2E) as parallel background jobs and checking in as each completes keeps wall-clock time down without losing orchestration control.
When a suspicious test failure looks environment-specific, decisively test the hypothesis (e.g., swap in main's version of a file and re-run) rather than reasoning about it indefinitely.
Red-green verification of a new regression test (confirm it fails against the unfixed code, then confirm it passes after the fix) is worth the extra step to prove the test actually catches the bug.

Delegating large mechanical or self-contained review-response passes (fixing a batch of CodeRabbit findings across UX-layer files vs. test files) to separate subagents in parallel keeps the orchestrator's context free while still allowing adversarial verification of results.
Delegating artifact-mining work (learnings extraction across 24 plan/summary docs) to a subagent conserves orchestrator context for a task that's read-heavy and self-contained.

friction: SDK E2E TEE tests failed for purely environmental reasons (stale tee-worker container image, and API pointed at the wrong TEE_WORKER_URL port) requiring multi-layer debugging through Redis queue state, container logs, and compose file discovery before the real (non-code) cause was found.

A web vitest failure in ipns.service.test.ts triggered an extended investigation (diffing against main, tracing import chains, swapping in main's file) before concluding it was pre-existing and not actually run in CI.

The CodeRabbit CLI review surfaced 19+ in-scope findings spanning SDK, API, and web layers, requiring extensive file-by-file triage, edits, and a second CodeRabbit re-run after fixes to confirm no new issues.
No existing service-level test coverage for updateGrant meant a new spec harness had to be built before adding the anti-rollback regression test.
